note: Emulsify Tools provides Twig helpers (bem(), add_attributes(), {% switch %}), theme-defined Twig namespaces (components.namespaces in a theme .info.yml, referenced as @atoms/button.twig), Drush child-theme generation (emulsify_tools:bake alias emulsify) and favicon deployment commands. Its only persistent config is emulsify_tools.settings.admin_theme_favicon_themes (a sequence of theme machine names whose generated favicon also applies on admin pages; default []). No configure route, no permissions, no plugin types. Medium cases seed known theme names into admin_theme_favicon_themes and read them back; hard cases require adding/replacing entries in that list, verified against live config. Baseline restored to [] (install default). Favicon commands need an Emulsify 7.x theme (absent here), so execution cases stay grounded in the config the module owns.

evals.prompt: Using the Emulsify Tools Twig helpers, which function produces BEM class names in a template, and what class string does bem('title', ['small', 'red'], 'card') generate?
evals.expected_output: The bem() Twig function. bem('title', ['small','red'], 'card') => class="card__title card__title--small card__title--red".

evals.prompt: Which Drush command does Emulsify Tools provide to generate an Emulsify child theme, and what is its alias?
evals.expected_output: drush emulsify_tools:bake <name> (alias: drush emulsify <name>); it generates a child theme under themes/custom/<name>.

evals.prompt: How does a theme register component Twig namespaces so Emulsify Tools resolves them (e.g. so templates can be referenced like @atoms/button.twig)?
evals.expected_output: Declare them in the theme's .info.yml under components.namespaces (same structure as the Components module), e.g. `components: { namespaces: { atoms: components/01-atoms } }`; then reference @atoms/button/button.twig.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Emulsify Tools is configured so that a theme's generated favicon is also applied on admin pages. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that theme.
Inspect the Emulsify Tools configuration on this site and list every theme configured to also use its generated favicon on admin pages.
Configure Emulsify Tools so that the 'olivero' theme's generated favicon package is also applied on admin pages. Apply the change to the live site.

Emulsify Tools currently lists a placeholder theme for admin-page favicons. Reconfigure it so that the ONLY theme whose generated favicon applies on admin pages is 'canvas_stark' (remove any other entries). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set emulsify_tools.settings.admin_theme_favicon_themes to ['canvas_stark'] (containing canvas_stark and not the placeholder).
